australianGraduatePathway.description: Australian university graduates of each state get easier nomination

notes: State nomination is REQUIRED — you cannot apply without it
Requires 2+ years relevant experience
Minimum 65 points on points test (state nomination adds 5 pts)
Family can accompany on permanent visa
Pathway to Australian citizenship (4 years residency)
🎓 Graduate of NSW university: easier pathway available
State nomination OR eligible family sponsor is REQUIRED
For regional areas of NSW
5-year provisional visa (can lead to permanence)
Must live/work in designated regional area
Lower points threshold (55) than SC 190
Can apply for permanence after 3 years if in regional area
🎓 Graduate of NSW university: easier pathway available
Job offer from an approved sponsoring employer is REQUIRED
Must have confirmed job offer in Australia
Employer sponsors the visa application
Temporary visa (2-4 years, extendable)
No points test required for some occupations
Can apply for permanence pathway after 2 years
